notes: iter_2 v3 patch. Starts from Dynojet stage tune (88.48 CID, currently on the bike). Fixes Engine Displacement 88.48 -> 103 (~16.4% more fuel command everywhere). Adds +1 deg cam advance in 2-4k RPM x 60-95 kPa. Notches WOT spark -2/-1 deg at the 5300 RPM knock cell on both cylinders. Decel enleanment set to 1.0 (no overrun fuel cut). Max Knock Retard capped at 4 deg. RPM Limit restored to 6.2 (OEM). AFR target, VE, Calibration ID, Speedo, Accel Enrichment, and Spark Adjust by ECT are byte-identical to the Dynojet stage. No O2 sensors on bike -- AFR validation in iter_3 requires dyno tailpipe wideband only.
